messages.text: Why did our churn rate spike last month?

args.purpose: Monthly customer churn rate over the last 12 months
args.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month
  FROM orders
  WHERE status != 'Cancelled'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT a.month, a.user_id, b.user_id IS NOT NULL AS retained
  FROM monthly AS a
  LEFT JOIN monthly AS b
    ON b.user_id = a.user_id AND b.month = DATE_ADD(a.month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  WHERE a.month BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH), MONTH)
                    AND DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), MONTH)
)
SELECT
  DATE_ADD(month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS churn_month,
  COUNT(*) AS customers_previous_month,
  ROUND(SUM(IF(retained, 0, 1)) / COUNT(*), 4) AS churn_rate
FROM cohort
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC
LIMIT 8

SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_new THEN user_id END) AS new_customers
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, created_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) = 1 AS is_new
  FROM orders
  WHERE status != 'Cancelled'
)
WHERE DATE(created_at) >= DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 8 MONTH), MONTH)
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month DESC
args.purpose: Check customer acquisition volume in preceding months
Churn rate in October 2026 by traffic source
args.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.user_id, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(oi.created_at), MONTH) AS month
  FROM order_items AS oi
  WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
),
cohort_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.traffic_source, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(o.created_at), MONTH) AS month
  FROM users AS u
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.user_id = u.id
  WHERE o.status != 'Cancelled'
    AND DATE_TRUNC(DATE(o.created_at), MONTH) = DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), MONTH)
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    cb.traffic_source,
    cb.user_id,
    m.user_id IS NOT NULL AS retained
  FROM cohort_base AS cb
  LEFT JOIN monthly AS m
    ON m.user_id = cb.user_id AND m.month = DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), MONTH)
)
SELECT
  traffic_source,
  COUNT(*) AS customers_sep,
  ROUND(1 - AVG(IF(retained, 1, 0)), 4) AS churn_rate_in_oct
FROM cohort
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY customers_sep DESC

WITH cohort_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id AS user_id, u.country, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(o.created_at), MONTH) AS month
  FROM users AS u
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.user_id = u.id
  WHERE o.status != 'Cancelled'
    AND DATE_TRUNC(DATE(o.created_at), MONTH) = DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), MONTH)
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(created_at), MONTH) AS month
  FROM orders
  WHERE status != 'Cancelled'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    cb.country,
    cb.user_id,
    m.user_id IS NOT NULL AS retained
  FROM cohort_base AS cb
  LEFT JOIN monthly AS m
    ON m.user_id = cb.user_id AND m.month = DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), MONTH)
)
SELECT
  country,
  COUNT(*) AS customers_sep,
  ROUND(1 - AVG(IF(retained, 1, 0)), 4) AS churn_rate_in_oct
FROM cohort
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY customers_sep DESC
